kinds.title: Note identification
kinds.objective: Name notes on the keyboard, including enharmonic names and octave numbers.

kinds.title: Name the interval
kinds.objective: Name the interval between two notes by size and quality.

kinds.title: Build an interval
kinds.objective: Spell the note a given interval above or below another note.

kinds.title: Spell a scale
kinds.objective: Construct major, minor, modal and other scales with correct spelling.

kinds.title: Key signatures
kinds.objective: Relate keys to their sharps and flats.

kinds.title: Spell a triad
kinds.objective: Spell major, minor, diminished, augmented and suspended triads.

kinds.title: Identify a triad
kinds.objective: Name a triad from the notes on the keyboard, including slash chords.

kinds.title: Chord inversions
kinds.objective: Tell which chord tone is in the bass.

kinds.title: Spell a seventh chord
kinds.objective: Spell seventh and sixth chords, including half- and fully diminished.

kinds.title: Identify a seventh chord
kinds.objective: Name seventh chords and their inversions from the keyboard.

kinds.title: Diatonic chords
kinds.objective: Build triads and sevenths on each degree of a scale.

kinds.title: Roman numeral analysis
kinds.objective: Label a chord with its Roman numeral in a key.

kinds.title: Numerals to chords
kinds.objective: Write the chord a Roman numeral stands for in a key.

kinds.title: Spell a progression
kinds.objective: Write common progressions in any key.

kinds.title: Smooth voice leading
kinds.objective: Choose the inversion that moves the least.

kinds.title: Identify cadences
kinds.objective: Recognise authentic, plagal, half and deceptive cadences.

kinds.title: Secondary dominants
kinds.objective: Build applied dominant and leading-tone chords.

kinds.title: Borrowed chords
kinds.objective: Spot chords borrowed from the parallel mode.

kinds.title: Extended chords
kinds.objective: Name ninth, eleventh, thirteenth and altered chords.

kinds.title: Harmonic substitution
kinds.objective: Find tritone substitutes and related ii chords for dominant chords.

kinds.title: Ear training: intervals
kinds.objective: Recognise intervals by ear.

kinds.title: Ear training: chord quality
kinds.objective: Recognise chord qualities by ear.

kinds.title: Ear training: cadences
kinds.objective: Recognise cadences by ear.
